R0262.title: Fake Handover Fee Fraud
R0262.definition: Forging transit handover nodes and records to fraudulently claim handover fees and transit subsidies.
R0262.description:
Fake handover fee fraud fabricates or duplicate-enters transit handover nodes and records, inflating handover counts and transit mileage to claim handover fees and transit subsidies, often involving cross-site or partner collusion.

The risk causes inflated handover-fee and transit-subsidy expenditure and distorts transit network data. Detection must combine handover node-trajectory comparison, transit tamper-proofing, and abnormal handover monitoring.
R0262.influence: Fake handover fee fraud causes inflated handover-fee and transit-subsidy expenditure, distorts transit network data, and may mask goods exceptions.

observables: Transit handoff nodes and handoff records are forged or duplicated
Handoff counts and transit mileage inflate accompanied by anomalous subsidy payouts
Handoff-node trajectory comparison shows records inconsistent with reality
Anomalous handoffs concentrate on cross-station or partner-collusion scenarios
Transit tamper-proofing is missing or bypassed
